Faq.q12: Does AI Menu Manager change my menu automatically?
Faq.a12: No. AI Menu Manager prepares cards. Important work such as prices, bulk updates, publishing, and generated images needs owner approval before it goes live.
Faq.q13: Is AI Menu Manager a customer chatbot?
Faq.a13: No. It is an owner-side menu operations feature. Customers do not chat with it. Owners use it to prepare menu updates inside MenuList.
Faq.q14: Can staff use AI Menu Manager?
Faq.a14: Staff access depends on the permissions the owner gives them. High-risk work still follows approval rules and cannot bypass owner-controlled access.
Faq.q15: Can it update Zomato, Swiggy, Google, or Instagram directly?
Faq.a15: No. MenuList does not publish to or update those platforms from AI Menu Manager. Unsupported destinations show a not-supported card and MenuList truth stays unchanged.

Features.group4F2Desc: Activate a festival or event menu with a scheduled automatic switch-back. You set it once — it reverts itself.
Features.group4F3Desc: Closed today? Opening late? Add a time-bound banner that disappears when it is no longer needed.

Features.group4F5Desc: A simple status checklist shows where your menu is visible — Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, QR, screens — and which surfaces still need setup.
Features.group4F6Desc: Pre-written messages for "Send menu", "Where are you?", and "Are you open?" — with your link, address, and hours included. One tap to copy and send.
Features.group4F7Desc: Bulk operations for pricing, availability, categories, and status. Select multiple items and apply changes in one action — with full preview before applying.
Features.group4F8Desc: For connected systems, approved menu changes can send a signed full-menu snapshot after publish.
Features.group4F9Desc: Use MenuList from a phone browser or installed PWA to edit menus, publish changes, share QR/link assets, review feedback, check Business Health, manage screens, adjust key settings, and handle daily operations without waiting for a desktop.
Features.group4F10Desc: Add staff with email or Staff ID and passcode, choose what each role can access, reset passcodes, and sign out old sessions when staff changes.
Features.group4F11Desc: Customers can report wrong prices, missing items, outdated details, or service concerns from the public view. You review it privately and correct the approved source.
Features.group4F12Desc: Owner workspace language preference, timezone, date format, and time format stay together. Customer-facing menu languages remain tied to the approved source.
